title: Add rust-ipfs = 0.15 dependency to reader Cargo.toml
description:
What: Add rust-ipfs 0.15 to crates/reader/Cargo.toml.
Algorithm:
1. Open crates/reader/Cargo.toml
2. Under [dependencies], add: rust-ipfs = "0.15"
3. Run cargo build -p usenet-ipfs-reader to verify it compiles
4. Run cargo test -p usenet-ipfs-reader to verify tests still pass
Defensive: no feature flags unless required; additive only.
Acceptance: cargo build clean, cargo test clean.
